titles: Frieren - Oltre la Fine del Viaggio
คำอธิษฐานในวันที่จากลา Frieren
Frieren e a Jornada para o Além
Frieren – Nach dem Ende der Reise
Frieren: Más allá del final del viaje

source.description: Sein is a Priest from a small village in the Alt Woods. After [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) spotted his talent, he joined her group for a period of time with the goal of reuniting with his childhood friend Gorilla.

characters.name: Aura
nicknames: Dantoudai no Aura (断頭台のアウラ)

name_alternative: Dantoudai no Aura (断頭台のアウラ)
source.description:
Aura is one of the Seven Sages of Destruction directly serving the Demon King. 

~!She later was killed by [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) after being commanded to kill herself using her own Auserlese.!~
He is an elf that Frieren's group meets in a cabin in the mountains. He's a monk and believed to be the last elf alive until meeting Frieren.
She lived a millennium before the story and was [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren)'s teacher.

An elven mage who is said to possess knowledge about nearly every magic that exists. She was Flamme's master. She founded the Continental Magic Association around 20 years before Himmel's death. First-class mages get the privilege of meeting her and can ask for any magic they desire.
A mage that can use restraint and mental manipulation magic. Good at detecting mana and can use simple recovery magic.
First-class mage who was a proctor for the first examination.
A third-class mage. Specializes in magic that makes her move at high speed. Treats [Denken](https://anilist.co/character/246058/Denken) as her grandfather.

Übel is a third-class mage. Was disqualified in an earlier examination due to killing a first-class wizard. Specializes in magic that allows her to copy the spells of people she can empathize with. Relies mostly on her intuition and is not bound by logical reasoning. ~!Becomes a first-class mage after the examination.!~

Denken is an imperial mage of the second-class. In his youth he belonged to an army but became an imperial mage after winning a power struggle. Often calm and calculating, however he still has a fire burning within despite his old age. He saw [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) as his motivation to become a mage. ~!Becomes a first-class mage after the examination.!~
Lawine is a third-class mage in the Second Party of the First Class Mage Examinations. She specializes in manipulating ice.

Kanne is a third-class mage who graduated from the Academy of Magic. She is childhood friends and classmates with [Lawine](https://anilist.co/character/293727), and the two entered the first-class mage exam together. In the first stage of the exam, she was paired with Lawine and [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754).

characters.name: Qual
nicknames: Fuhai no Ken Rou (腐敗の賢老)

name_alternative: Fuhai no Ken Rou (腐敗の賢老)
source.description: A feared and powerful demon who served the Demon King.
Edel is a second-class mage in the Seventeenth Party, alongside Blei and Dunst, of the First Class Mage Exam. She specializes in Hypnosis Magic.
Lügner was a demon who served [Aura the Guillotine](https://anilist.co/character/219110/Aura).

Linie is a Demon working under [Aura](https://anilist.co/character/219110/Aura). Under Aura's instruction, she was sent to assist [Lügner](https://anilist.co/character/316985/Lgner) alongside [Draht](https://anilist.co/character/316987/Draht) to perform negotiations with [Graf Granat](https://anilist.co/character/318147/Granat-Hakushaku).
Draht was a demon who served [Aura the Guillotine](https://anilist.co/character/219110/Aura).
Ruler of Graf Granat's Domain, a fortified city in the Northern Lands constantly at war with Aura.
Stark's older brother, referred to as the strongest warrior in the village.

The current chief of the Village of the Sword. Her position was inherited. She is young for the position and postures to try to make up for her lack of height, but when faced with danger or matters regarding the Hero's Blade, she is collected and calm.

Second-class mage and the leader of the eighth party during the first stage of the First Class Mage Exam. He is the captain of the Northern Magic Corps and is thus a very experienced mage. Specializes in magic that restrains the opponent when their body is in full-view.
Second-class mage who participates in the First Class Mage Exam at the same time as Frieren and Fern. He owns a magical store in Äußerst where he specializes in repairing broken staves.
Second-class mage in the Eighth Party, alongside Wirbel and Scharf, in the First Class Mage Exam. Fern feels that she is the strongest within both the Fourth and Eighth parties.
Second-class mage in the Fourth Party of the First Class Mage Examination. He specializes in illusion magic.
First-class mage that is proctoring the Second Exam of the First Class Mage Examination. She is a solemn person who rarely speaks.

Participant in the examination for the title of mage first class.
~!Sacrificed himself to help Dunst deliver important information to his comrades in the lower level of the dungeon.!~
First class mage. Acts as an observer in magical exams.
Participant in the examination for the title of mage first class. Slightly distracted girl. Likes to read books and learn new spells.

Childhood friend of [Sein](https://anilist.co/character/205177) who dreamed of going on an adventure and becoming a legendary hero. A long time ago, he asked Sein to start adventuring with him, which Sein refused and regretted since.
Nobleman presiding over the Vorig Fortified City and the current head of the Orden family, one of the Three Great Knightly Houses of the Northern Lands.
Servant of [Lord Orden](https://anilist.co/character/326825).
Elderly Dwarf warrior and a long-time friend of Frieren. He resides in a village in the Klar Region.

An old friend of Denken. First Class Mage and Serie's apprentice. Rarely acts directly, preferring stealth.
~!Helped in the extraction and transfer of information necessary for the liberation of Denken's hometown.!~
Participant in the examination for the title of mage first class. Distrustful and self-confident mage.
Participant in the First Class Mage Exam.

The King resides in the Royal Capital in the Central Lands. The King's influence reaches across the Central and Northern Lands. When the Hero Party first set out on their journey to defeat the Demon King, he provided them with ten copper coins.
A herbalist that lives in a village in the Turk Region.
An adventurer that hangs out in a tavern in Warm.
An elder wearing a straw hat in the village by where Qual is sealed. Himmel would talk with him when he visited to check on the condition of the seal.

characters.name: Sonchou A
nicknames: Granz Kaikyou no Sonchou (グランツ海峡の村長)

name_alternative: Granz Kaikyou no Sonchou (グランツ海峡の村長)
source.description: An elder that lives in the Granz Channel. He offers [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) and [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965/Fern) a fake of one of the [Great Mage Flamme](https://anilist.co/character/219733/Flamme)'s grimoires as payment for cleaning up the shore of the channel by the New Year's Anniversary and checks up on them throughout their stay in town.

A kind woman that owns a bakery in the Granz Channel. She gives [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965/Fern) extra bread for being a regular customer while [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) and Fern stay in town to clean up the shore.
A old lady that is seen taking care of two young children in Riegel Canyon.
A child from Riegel Canyon. He adores [Stark](https://anilist.co/character/184313/Stark) and seek his attention.
A woman who live in the village [Stark](https://anilist.co/character/184313/Stark) protected in Riegel Canyon.

source.description: [Stark](https://anilist.co/character/184313/Stark)'s father is a harsh, militant man. He considers Stark a failure. He is also strict with the other warriors of the village, scolding them for their pathetic display against a monster and praising [Stoltz](https://anilist.co/character/319598/Stoltz), who he considered the pride of the village, for defeating it while keeping his white cape pristine.
Lord Orden's youngest son and the next heir of the Orden family.
Lord Orden's oldest son. Wirt passed away in a melee against demon forces but managed to kill the enemy general.
The head chef for the restaurant Bell in Äußerst.
